reasons.action: The caller explicitly asks for the line to be said again word for word, an intelligible requested vocal performance; performance authority is action authority, so the requested behavior governs.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is supplied — the sole asset is an audio voice-timbre reference — so the host-owned no-reference permission leaves the rendering medium request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference and no observed subjects exist to supply clothing, so wardrobe falls to the request.
reasons.lighting: The audio reference carries no lighting information and no illuminating source or light direction is specified, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is described and the audio reference cannot supply framing; the 16:9 canvas ratio alone does not authorize a framing decision, so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: The audio reference supplies only voice timbre and delivery, carrying no color or tonal information, so palette is request-governed.
